14317.d: The Infernal Source Dig Site is a dig site just west of the Jolly Boar Inn (outside the northern gates of Varrock) that players can first access at level 20 Archaeology, upon receiving an invitation from Movario - a Zamorakian scholar.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
There are a variety of ways to travel to the entrance of the Infernal Source dig site.
• Archaeology teleport, purchased for 250 chronotes from Ezreal at the Archaeology Guild Shop
• Archaeology journal, teleport to the Archaeology Campus then running west and use the dig sites map table to teleport to it directly
• Archaeology journal, teleport to the Archaeology Campus then running north-west
• Master Archaeologist's Outfit, teleport to the Infernal Source Dig Site
• Fort Forinthry Teleport, obtained from all levels of Treasure Trails clues
• Fort Forinthry lodestone, requires construction after completion of the New Foundations quest
• Earth altar teleport and head north-west
• Balloon transport system to Varrock near the Jolly Boar Inn, then running west
• Invitation box, teleport to the Empyrean Citadel, then again to Silvarea, then running west

14374.d: Invention banner is found in the Max Guild garden.

14375.d: The Invention Guild is located north-east of Falador, immediately south-west of the entrance to the Dwarven mines, and north of the Gamers' Grotto entrance.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• A skill portal in the Max Guild garden can be attuned to the Invention Guild. It teleports the player inside. A grace of the elves will teleport the player to the portals' attuned locations.
• Use a skills necklace to teleport directly outside the Guild door.
• Teleporting to the Falador lodestone and running north-east.
• A games necklace can teleport the player to the Gamers' Grotto, by the exit. Upon exiting, the entrance to the Invention Guild will be to the north.
